goal: Help agents gather clean, trainable datasets from agent-memory for SFT and RL workflows.
workflow: 1) Select scope: per-project (`project=<path|name>`) or global (omit project).
2) Start with `sft` export and `include_errors=false` for high-precision baseline.
3) Add `trajectory` export with observation linkage for outcome-aware training.
4) Add `preference` export for chosen/rejected pairs (DPO/RM pipelines).
5) Apply reward filters (`min_reward`, `max_reward`) to isolate quality bands.
6) Keep an explicit hard-negative split from problematic/errorful traces.

dataset_params.project: optional project full path or short name

trajectory.description: Outcome-aware traces with optional observation context.

problematic_trace_rules: error-like output patterns (permission denied, command not found, traceback, fatal, non-zero exits)
recommendations: Train on `include_errors=false` first, then add controlled negatives.
Require observation linkage for higher-confidence trajectory/reward tuning when possible.
Use per-project exports for domain behavior and global exports for general reliability.
